title: Jenta

  • Ekakanipāta The Book of the Ones
  • Dvādasamavagga Chapter Twelve

Jentattheragāthā Jenta

“Duppabbajjaṁ ve duradhivāsā gehā, Going forth is hard; living at home is hard; Dhammo gambhīro duradhigamā bhogā; Dhamma is profound; money is hard to come by. Kicchā vutti no itarītareneva, Getting by is difficult for we who accept whatever comes, Yuttaṁ cintetuṁ satatamaniccatan”ti. so we should always think about impermanence.

… Jento thero ….
